findings.observation: Delay arms counter 0x455204 and flag 0x455206; timer loads halfword, decrements, and clears flag at zero.
findings.implication: A four-byte low-word store at 0x241ac7 clears the adjacent flag for any decremented count <=65535. Halfword stores preserve the countdown contract.

findings.observation: Timer loads halfword at 0x4551f6, computes minus one, stores at decoded 0x4551f4, then reloads 0x4551f6.
findings.implication: Low-halfword store at decoded address+2 fits decrement/reload behavior; literal pinned SLEIGH store does not.

limitations: Firmware-derived consistency evidence, not independent ISA or physical clock validation.
All-displacement scan may decode data or mid-instruction bytes; no resolved base register is implied.
No new verified ownership established for neighbors of 0x4551a8 or 0x4551ec.
Runtime callback assignments, interrupt caller and channel timer side effects remain unresolved.
